About Chitkabra.

Based in Jaipur, India, Chitkabra Creatives is an independent motion design and video production studio turning complex ideas into fluid visual stories.

Founded by Devashish Sharma, the studio is backed by over 15 years of motion design and production expertise, delivering high-end animation and seamless execution to modern brands and fast-moving agency pipelines.
